study_status: redesign after diagnosing the earlier source-model failure
development_amendment: Before any new-source test scoring: suppress protocol and leading www in the learning view after development-only validation identified a 100% www/https pattern in source legitimate URLs. Canonical identity, domain grouping and labels remain unchanged; earlier v2 candidates are retained.
new_source: Hannousse and Yahiouche, Mendeley Data V3, DOI 10.17632/c2gw7fy2j4.3
new_source_partition: StratifiedGroupKFold with five folds: folds 0-2 are final evaluation, folds 3-4 supply the new-source replay; remove every new-source domain from development before model fitting
development_partition: StratifiedGroupKFold with five folds: folds 0-2 training, fold 3 validation, fold 4 internal test; grouping shared across both development sources
quality_policy: Shared across sources: retain published labels; require HTTP(S) hostname; exclude internal whitespace, angle brackets and double quotes; normalize scheme/host case and empty root path to slash; preserve meaningful path/query/fragment case; remove duplicates and all conflicting normalized URL keys
training_sampling: Up to 30000 rows per source/class and up to 12 rows per source/class/domain; fixed before model fitting; balance source/class and domain contribution through sample weights
numeric_features: 45 statistics of the root-normalized learning view with protocol fixed and leading www suppressed; 44 inputs after excluding has_https; representation length names distinguish them from raw URL lengths
char_features: TF-IDF character 3-5 grams of normalized authority/path/query/fragment, omitting scheme, min_df=3, max_features=80000; fit vocabulary on training rows only
threshold_rule: Smallest threshold respecting observed legitimate-row FPR budget in every represented validation source; ties excluded together; report recall and domain-macro rates separately
selection_rule: Highest mean validation macro-source phishing recall at the primary operating point across the three seeds; tie by validation macro-source AP, then listed family order; no test result used for model or threshold selection
replay_feedback: Only revealed labels; split refitting and calibration domains; version both estimator and cutoff; reset detector after decision change and ignore delayed errors from older decision versions, while scoring all original predictions
new_source_test_policy: Score after development selection is frozen; evaluation domains never appear in fitting/calibration/replay; retain all results; if later redesign uses observed outcomes, mark it exploratory rather than pretending the same test is still blind
previous_wangchuk_holdout: Reused diagnostic only, not fresh confirmatory evidence
target_interpretation: Study acceptance targets, not a guarantee of deployment reliability or universal false-alarm control
temporal_scope: Archived real records in constructed orders; collection month/year does not supply per-record natural-time chronology
numerical_reproduction_amendment: Forest fitting retains4workers; calibration/inference uses1worker to fix tree summation order. This corrects repeated-run floating-point boundary variation without changing training hyperparameters or choosing settings from test detection performance. Existing historical runs remain preserved and already-inspected.
